svg.title: Internet store: Kafka in the system architecture
svg.desc: A reference architecture, not a deployment blueprint. Order and confirmed payment state are persisted with an outbox. A publisher sends events into a partitioned replicated Kafka topic. Four independent Consumer Groups drive inventory, notifications, analytics and billing with their own stores or APIs. Notification recovery topics are drawn in the logical notification pipeline. Schema Registry provides the producer event schema; monitoring observes Kafka. Motion illustrates data flow, not measured latency or exactly-once delivery.

g.text: Recovery Topics also live in Kafka
